input.value: ObjectNode with any content (e.g., empty object)

cases.expected: currentDiscriminatorContext.markMatch() is called exactly once; after execution currentDiscriminatorContext.isDiscriminatorMatchFound() returns true
cases.description: When the discriminator property value is null the method should immediately mark a match on the context and return without inspecting the discriminator mapping.

input.value: MockJsonSchema where implicit mapping for "cat" resolves to a subschema

cases.expected: checkForImplicitDiscriminatorMappingMatch is invoked; after execution currentDiscriminatorContext.isDiscriminatorMatchFound() returns true
cases.description: If the discriminator object does not contain a "mapping" field, the method should fall back to the implicit discriminator mapping logic and mark a match when the implicit mapping resolves.

cases.expected: checkForExplicitDiscriminatorMappingMatch finds the key and marks a match; currentDiscriminatorContext.isDiscriminatorMatchFound() returns true and no implicit check is performed
cases.description: When an explicit mapping is present and the discriminator property value matches a key in that mapping, the method should record a match via the explicit‑mapping logic and skip any implicit mapping.

input.value: MockJsonSchema where implicit mapping for "fish" resolves to a subschema and no explicit‑key override is defined

cases.expected: explicit mapping check does not find a match; noExplicitDiscriminatorKeyOverride returns true; implicit mapping is evaluated and marks a match; currentDiscriminatorContext.isDiscriminatorMatchFound() returns true
cases.description: If the explicit mapping does not contain the discriminator value but the schema does not forbid an implicit fallback (no explicit‑key override), the method should try the implicit mapping and succeed.

input.value: MockJsonSchema where an explicit‑key override is defined for "hamster" (noImplicit=true) so implicit mapping must be ignored

cases.expected: explicit mapping check does not find a match; noExplicitDiscriminatorKeyOverride returns false; implicit mapping is NOT evaluated; currentDiscriminatorContext.isDiscriminatorMatchFound() remains false
cases.description: When the explicit mapping does not match and the parent schema defines an explicit‑key override that disables implicit fallback, the method must leave the context without a match.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown because discriminator is null and the method attempts discriminator.get("mapping")
cases.description: Passing a null discriminator ObjectNode should cause an NPE before any mapping logic is evaluated.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when the method forwards the null jsonSchema to checkForImplicitDiscriminatorMappingMatch
cases.description: If the JsonSchema argument is null, the implicit mapping helper receives a null reference and throws NPE.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or ClassCastException) is thrown because checkForExplicitDiscriminatorMappingMatch expects an object node for the mapping but receives an array node
cases.description: Providing a mapping field whose value is not a JSON object should cause the explicit‑mapping helper to fail with a type‑mismatch exception.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when checkForExplicitDiscriminatorMappingMatch attempts to iterate over a null mapping node
cases.description: When the "mapping" field exists but its value is JSON null, the method treats it as a non‑null JsonNode and later dereferences it, causing NPE.

input.value: MockJsonSchema where implicit mapping for "unknownAnimal" does NOT resolve to any subschema (throws SchemaException)

cases.expected: SchemaException (or RuntimeException) is thrown by checkForImplicitDiscriminatorMappingMatch because the implicit discriminator reference cannot be resolved
cases.description: If the implicit discriminator mapping points to a non‑existent subschema, the helper method throws an exception that propagates out of checkDiscriminatorMatch.

input.value: MockJsonSchema where the reference "#/components/schemas/NonExistingDog" cannot be resolved (throws SchemaException)

cases.expected: SchemaException (or IllegalArgumentException) is thrown by checkForExplicitDiscriminatorMappingMatch when it tries to load a non‑existent subschema
cases.description: An explicit mapping that points to an undefined schema reference should cause the explicit‑mapping helper to raise an exception.
